title: myosurus minimus var. sessiliflorus
intro: Myosurus minimus var. sessiliflorus, commonly known as Sessile-topped mouse tail, is a variety of the Myosurus minimus plant, which belongs to the Ranunculaceae family and is native to North America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can aid in relieving pain, reducing inflammation, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Myosurus minimus var. sessiliflorus include its ability to act as a diuretic, expectorant, and antispasmodic, making it useful in treating conditions such as urinary issues, bronchitis, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
